# Pesher Habakkuk Column 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** Well preserved; contains Day of Atonement passage

---

**11:1** "Woe to him who gains evil profit for his house,

**11:2** to set his nest on high,

**11:3** to be delivered from the power of evil!" (Hab 2:9)

**11:4** Its interpretation concerns the priest who [...]

**11:5** so that the sentence against him would be the judgment of fire.

**11:6** "You have devised shame for your house

**11:7** by cutting off many peoples, and you sin

**11:8** against your own soul.

**11:9** For the stone will cry out from the wall,

**11:10** and the beam from the woodwork

**11:11** will answer it" (Hab 2:10-11).

**11:12** [Its interpretation] concerns the Wicked Priest,

**11:13** who pursued the Teacher of Righteousness to his house of exile,

**11:14** to swallow him up in his fierce anger.

**11:15** And at the time of the festival of rest, the Day of Atonement,

**11:16** he appeared before them to swallow them up

**11:17** and to cause them to stumble on the day of fasting, their sabbath of rest.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 11 covers Hab 2:9-11. This consensus translation harmonizes the best renderings from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. The pesher format — alternating biblical quotation and sectarian interpretation — is preserved throughout. Key sectarian titles maintained: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, Kittim, Spouter of the Lie. "Interpretation" for pesher (per LOGOS). Lacunae [...] are genuine manuscript gaps. See disagreement log for resolution details.*
